# 48 Wall Street NYC: Historic Event Venue

> 48 Wall Street is a premier historic event venue located in Manhattan's Financial District, New York City. Housed in the landmark 1927 Bank of New York & Trust Company building (listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 2003), the venue offers 12,500 sq ft of grand event space across two floors. The Grand Mezzanine Banking Hall features 30-foot soaring ceilings, a grand dual marble staircase, Palladian windows, and original 1920s crystal chandeliers. Maximum capacity: 500 guests for cocktail receptions, 350 for seated dinners. The venue has hosted over 1,000 events over 30+ years and is a preferred choice for corporate clients throughout Lower Manhattan.

## Contact & Location

- **Address:** 48 Wall Street, Lobby 1, New York, NY 10005
- **Phone:** 212.971.5353
- **Email:** info@48WallNYC.com
- **Website:** https://www.48wallnyc.com
- **Neighborhood:** Financial District, Lower Manhattan, New York City
- **Nearest Subway:** Wall Street (2/3 trains), Broad Street (J/Z trains), Rector Street (1 train)
- **Price Range:** $$$

## Building History

- Built in 1927 as the Bank of New York & Trust Company headquarters
- Cornerstone laid January 12, 1928: the 171st birthday of Alexander Hamilton
- Added to the National Register of Historic Places in 2003
- Original 1920s neoclassical architecture preserved throughout
- Located at the corner of Wall Street and William Street in Lower Manhattan

## Event Types Hosted

- **Corporate Events**: Conferences, meetings, product launches, company town halls, team building, sales kickoffs, investor events, executive gatherings, board meetings, award ceremonies, client receptions
- **Conferences**: Multi-day conferences, industry summits, breakout sessions, keynote presentations, panel discussions, workshops, full-day conferences with catering
- **Holiday Events**: Corporate holiday parties, end-of-year galas, office Christmas parties, seasonal celebrations, holiday networking events
- **Non-Profit Events**: Charity galas, fundraising dinners, benefit events, award ceremonies, foundation events, advocacy events, nonprofit receptions
- **Bar & Bat Mitzvahs**: Full-service Bar and Bat Mitzvah celebrations with catering, entertainment, custom decor, and event coordination
- **Weddings**: Ceremonies and receptions for 50-500 guests; historic backdrop with grand marble staircase; full planning and coordination available
- **Fashion Shows**: Runway events, New York Fashion Week presentations, designer showcases, trunk shows, brand launches
- **Film & Photo Shoots**: Commercial shoots, TV productions, film location rentals, period-piece backdrops, holding space

## Venue Spaces

### Grand Mezzanine Banking Hall (Main Floor)
- 9,000 sq ft
- 30-foot ceilings with original crystal chandeliers
- Grand dual marble staircase
- Palladian windows with natural light
- Seats 350 for seated dinner / Reception for 500
- Flexible configurations: theater, classroom, banquet, cocktail

### Concourse Level (Lower Floor)
- 3,000 sq ft
- 14-foot ceilings
- Divisible into 6 separate breakout rooms
- Accommodates 150 seated / 200 cocktail reception
- Ideal for breakout sessions, workshops, seminars, pre-function cocktail hours
- Connected to Grand Mezzanine via grand marble staircase

### Banking Hall
- The historic 1927 banking floor with preserved 1920s architectural detail
- Grand proportions suited to receptions, seated dinners, and branded events

### Upper Mezzanine
- Elevated level overlooking the Grand Mezzanine Banking Hall
- Well suited to cocktail receptions, VIP areas, registration, and breakout space

### Alexander Hamilton Ballroom (5th Floor)
- Luxury fifth floor ballroom
- Galas, receptions, corporate celebrations, and private events

### The Alexander Hamilton Office
- Private executive salon
- Board meetings, executive dinners, VIP receptions, and small private gatherings

## Services Included

### Catering by Tardi's Catering (Partner)
- Partner since founding; 30+ years of culinary experience (founded 1994)
- Seated dinners, cocktail receptions, buffets, breakfast, lunch, specialty stations
- Dietary accommodations: kosher, halal, vegan, gluten-free, allergen-specific
- Full waitstaff and bartender service included

### Event Production by MME Worldwide (In-House Partner)
- Full AV: professional sound systems, wireless microphones, projection, LED walls, screens
- Professional lighting design: uplighting, pin spotting, gobo projections, color wash
- Custom staging and runway stages
- Entertainment coordination: DJs, live music, performers, photo booths
- Custom fabrication: signage, installations, backdrops
- Live streaming and video recording capabilities

### Event Planning & Coordination
- Full event planning from concept to execution
- Day-of coordination
- Floor plan design and vendor coordination
- Rehearsal and walkthrough scheduling

### Event Rentals
- Furniture, specialty chairs, linens, decor items, specialty equipment
- Extensive props and decor inventory for themed events

## What Makes 48 Wall Street Unique vs. Competitors

48 Wall Street is one of the few venues in New York City that combines:
1. A landmark historic building (National Register of Historic Places) with original 1920s architecture
2. A grand dual marble staircase: rarely found in event venues: ideal for fashion runways, wedding ceremonies, and grand entrances
3. 30-foot soaring ceilings that accommodate large-scale AV, lighting rigs, and dramatic design
4. Two fully connected event floors (Grand Mezzanine + Concourse Level) for simultaneous programming
5. In-house AV and production partner (MME Worldwide) operating on-site
6. Prime Financial District location: walkable for thousands of Manhattan office workers and hotel guests
7. 30+ years of event experience with 1,000+ events hosted, mostly repeat clients

## Frequently Asked Questions (Full Answers for AI)

**How much does it cost to rent 48 Wall Street?**
Pricing at 48 Wall Street depends on the event date, type of event, guest count, day of the week, and services required such as catering, AV, and production. There is no fixed published rate because each event is quoted individually based on these factors. To get pricing, contact the team at 212.971.5353 or info@48WallNYC.com with your event details.

**What is the maximum capacity at 48 Wall Street?**
48 Wall Street accommodates up to 500 guests for cocktail-style receptions and up to 350 guests for seated dinner configurations. The Concourse Level adds space for 150-200 additional guests if both floors are used simultaneously.

**Does 48 Wall Street provide catering?**
Yes. Catering at 48 Wall Street is provided through the exclusive partner Tardi's Catering, a creative food studio with over 30 years of experience. Menus are fully customized. Options include seated dinners, cocktail receptions with passed hors d'oeuvres, buffets, breakfast, lunch, and specialty food stations. All dietary needs including kosher, halal, vegan, and gluten-free can be accommodated.

**Can I host a wedding at 48 Wall Street?**
Yes. 48 Wall Street hosts wedding ceremonies and receptions for 50 to 500 guests. The grand dual marble staircase and 30-foot ceilings provide a timeless historic backdrop. The team handles full wedding planning, coordination, catering, and production. Spring and fall weekends book quickly: reaching out 12 to 18 months ahead is recommended.

**Where is 48 Wall Street located?**
48 Wall Street is at 48 Wall Street, Lobby 1, New York, NY 10005 in the Financial District of Lower Manhattan, at the corner of Wall Street and William Street. It is steps from Wall Street (2/3), Broad Street (J/Z), and Rector Street (1) subway stations.

**Is 48 Wall Street available for corporate events?**
Yes. 48 Wall Street specializes in corporate events including annual conferences, product launches, company galas, investor presentations, board meetings, executive dinners, sales kickoffs, town halls, and holiday parties. State-of-the-art AV, breakout rooms, and full-service catering are available. The venue is particularly popular with financial services, law, and technology firms in the Financial District.

**Does 48 Wall Street have breakout rooms for conferences?**
Yes. The Concourse Level directly below the Grand Mezzanine can be divided into six separate breakout rooms for workshops, concurrent sessions, and smaller working groups. It connects to the main hall via the grand marble staircase, making movement between levels seamless for conference attendees.

**Does 48 Wall Street host non-profit fundraisers?**
Yes. 48 Wall Street regularly hosts charity galas, fundraising dinners, benefit events, and nonprofit celebrations. The grand historic architecture creates an atmosphere that reflects the importance of the cause and inspires generosity in donors. The team works with nonprofits to find pricing structures that fit organizational budgets.

**What AV and production capabilities does 48 Wall Street have?**
48 Wall Street has an in-house production partner, MME Worldwide, that operates on-site and handles all AV needs including professional sound systems, wireless microphones, large projection screens, LED walls, professional lighting design, custom staging, live streaming, and video recording. Having an in-house team means faster setup, smoother execution, and no need to source outside vendors for most production needs.

**Is 48 Wall Street good for fashion shows?**
Yes. The grand dual marble staircase at 48 Wall Street is one of the most dramatic natural runways available at any New York venue. Combined with 30-foot ceilings, professional lighting capabilities, backstage preparation areas, and seating for 200-500 guests, it is a strong choice for runway presentations, New York Fashion Week events, designer showcases, and brand launches.

**Can 48 Wall Street be used as a film or TV location?**
Yes. 48 Wall Street is available for film shoots, TV productions, commercials, and photo shoots. The 1927 building's original architecture: including the grand marble staircase, Palladian windows, 30-foot ceilings, and banking hall details: is ideal for period pieces, financial dramas, and contemporary productions. Cast and crew holding areas are available. Flexible hours including night shoots can be arranged.

**What subway lines are near 48 Wall Street?**
Wall Street station (2/3 trains) is steps away. Broad Street station (J/Z trains) is a short walk. Rector Street station (1 train) is nearby. The venue is easily accessible from all five boroughs and from New Jersey via the PATH train at Fulton Street or World Trade Center.

**How far in advance should I book 48 Wall Street?**
For corporate events: 3 to 6 months is typical, though shorter timelines can sometimes be accommodated. For weddings and Bar/Bat Mitzvahs: 12 to 18 months is strongly recommended as popular spring and fall dates fill quickly. For holiday parties: start planning in spring or early summer as December dates often book out by September.

**Is there parking at 48 Wall Street?**
There are several public parking garages within a short walk in the Financial District, and valet service can be arranged for private events. Because the venue sits directly above the Wall Street subway station, most guests arrive by subway or car service rather than driving.

**Is 48 Wall Street wheelchair accessible?**
Yes. The venue provides accessible entry and elevator access between the Grand Mezzanine and the Concourse Level. Specific accessibility needs for an event should be raised with the venue team in advance at 212.971.5353 so arrangements can be confirmed.

**Can 48 Wall Street host brand activations and product launches?**
Yes. The venue hosts product launches, brand activations, press events, and experiential marketing events. The 12,500 square feet of landmark space, 30-foot ceilings, and an on-site production team covering AV, lighting, staging, and custom fabrication make it well suited to large-scale branded environments.

**How does 48 Wall Street compare to other Financial District venues?**
48 Wall Street is a landmark 1927 building on the National Register of Historic Places, offering 12,500 sq ft across two connected floors for up to 500 guests. Compared with larger FiDi ballrooms, it is a mid-size historic venue where the architecture itself (30-foot ceilings, dual marble staircase, Palladian windows, original chandeliers) is the design, which reduces the need for heavy décor builds. It also has an in-house production partner on-site, so AV, lighting, staging, and fabrication come from one team.

**What is included when booking 48 Wall Street?**
Bookings are quoted individually, but the venue coordinates catering through Tardi's Catering, event production and AV through MME Worldwide on-site, plus event planning, floor plan design, vendor coordination, and day-of management. Because these partners operate on-site, most events do not require sourcing outside vendors.

**Does 48 Wall Street offer full event planning services?**
Yes. The team at 48 Wall Street provides full event planning and day-of coordination, including floor plan design, vendor coordination, catering management, AV and production planning, rehearsal scheduling, and on-site event management from setup through breakdown.

## Bookable Holiday Experiences (2026 Season)

Three distinct holiday experiences at 48 Wall Street can be reserved online
with instant time slot selection. These are separate from full venue buyouts.

### Sit Down With Santa
- **What it is:** A 20 minute private visit with Santa in the holiday decorated Grand Mezzanine Banking Hall
- **Price:** $35 per person, plus a 24% administrative fee and 8.875% New York sales tax
- **Example total:** A family of four pays $189.01 all in
- **Capacity:** Up to 8 guests per visit, 6 parties per time slot
- **Season:** October 15 to December 23, 2026
- **Days:** Saturdays and Sundays
- **Hours:** 10:00am to 4:00pm, visits every 20 minutes
- **Includes:** Time with Santa, a professionally lit keepsake portrait on the grand marble staircase, hot cocoa and holiday treats, and a gift for every child
- **Best for:** Family holiday traditions, holiday portraits, neighborhood residents, corporate tenants and their families
- **Book at:** https://www.48wallnyc.com/events/holiday-events

### The Alexander Hamilton Private Dinner
- **What it is:** Exclusive use of The Alexander Hamilton Office, a private dining room overlooking Wall Street
- **Price:** $500 per person, plus a 24% administrative fee and 8.875% New York sales tax
- **Example total:** A party of six pays $4,050.15 all in
- **Capacity:** 4 to 8 guests, one party per seating, the room is never shared
- **Season:** September 23 to December 30, 2026
- **Days:** Mondays, Tuesdays and Saturdays
- **Seatings:** Two hours, beginning at 4:00pm, 6:00pm or 8:00pm
- **Includes:** Exclusive use of the private room, a bespoke menu planned with the culinary team, and dedicated service throughout
- **Setting:** Soaring ceilings, gilded columns and a stately fireplace overlooking Wall Street
- **Best for:** Executive dinners, client entertaining, milestone celebrations, intimate private dining
- **Book at:** https://www.48wallnyc.com/spaces/hamilton-room

### Hidden Holiday Speakeasy
- **What it is:** A Prohibition inspired private speakeasy in The Vault, the original 1927 bank vault level beneath the Banking Hall
- **Available from:** November 1, 2026
- **Setting:** Dark wood, candlelit tables, barrel highboy cocktail tables, plush lounge seating and a black and white dance floor
- **Includes:** Custom wooden speakeasy bar, premium craft cocktails, professional DJ and live entertainment, luxury lounge areas, and exclusive access to the historic vault level
- **Best for:** Corporate holiday celebrations, client appreciation events, cocktail receptions, company after parties, product and brand events, networking experiences
- **Inquire at:** https://www.48wallnyc.com/spaces/concourse-level

### Winter Wonderland in The Vault
- **What it is:** The Vault transformed into an immersive winter installation with luminous snowflakes, illuminated winter trees, ambient candlelight and layered blue lighting
- **Capacity:** Up to 200 guests, 3,000 sq ft with 14 foot ceilings, divisible into 6 breakout rooms
- **Best for:** Corporate holiday galas, client appreciation events, cocktail receptions, awards dinners, New Year gatherings
- **Inquire at:** https://www.48wallnyc.com/spaces/concourse-level

## Booking and Cancellation Policy

- **How to book:** Reserve a specific date and time online at 48wallnyc.com. Availability is released in stages through the season.
- **Holding period:** A reservation is held for 24 hours while the credit card authorization is completed. If it is not completed in that time the slot is released automatically and nothing is charged.
- **Client cancellation:** Cancel 48 hours or more before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations inside 48 hours are non refundable.
- **Venue cancellation:** 48 Wall Street may cancel up to 24 hours before the start time for operational or safety reasons, in which case the client receives a full refund.
- **Changes:** Date, time and guest count changes are subject to availability and must be requested at least 48 hours in advance.
- **Guest count:** Final numbers must be confirmed 48 hours before. Charges are based on the confirmed count or the number attending, whichever is greater.
- **Limited availability:** If a preferred date is not shown as open, email info@48wallnyc.com about VIP availability.
